english.title: Use a motor vehicle on a road when the speedometer was not maintained in good working order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when its speedometer was not maintained in good working order at all material times.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 36(1) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
use on a road
a motor vehicle
fitted with an instrument for indicating speed
which was required to be fitted
which was not maintained in good working order

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Regulation 36(2) defines 'all material times' and defines certain times as not being material.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H661, H662, H663, H664 and H665.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
